import numpy as np, collections
G=load()
# clean extraction of tiles for all three demos: find connected components per band
def components(g):
    H,W=g.shape
    seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r,c]!=0 and not seen[r,c]:
                # assume solid square blocks; grow bbox
                st=[(r,c)];cells=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    if seen[x,y]:continue
                    seen[x,y]=True;cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx in(-1,0,1):
                        for dy in(-1,0,1):
                            nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx,ny] and g[nx,ny]==g[x,y]:
                                st.append((nx,ny))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    g=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    comps=components(g)
    info=[]
    for cells in comps:
        rs=[c[0] for c in cells]; cs=[c[1] for c in cells]
        col_=collections.Counter(g[c] for c in cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
        info.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),col_,len(cells)))
    print(name,'comps:',info)
    # what changed
    D=list(np.argwhere(g!=o))
    print('changed:',collections.Counter(int(o[r,c]) for r,c,_ in [(int(r),int(c),g[int(r)][int(c)]) for r,c in D]))

import numpy as np, collections
def analyze(name):
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    H,W=i.shape
    # bands
    nz=[r for r in range(H) if any(i[r][c]!=0 for c in range(W))]
    bands=[];cur=[nz[0]]
    for r in nz[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: bands.append(cur);cur=[r]
    bands.append(cur)
    # tile centers per band: contiguous col runs, take middle col of each run
    res={}
    for bi,b in enumerate(bands):
        cs=sorted({c for r in b for c in range(W) if i[r][c]!=0})
        runs=[];run=[cs[0]]
        for c in cs[1:]:
            if c==run[-1]+1: run.append(c)
            else: runs.append(run);run=[c]
        runs.append(run)
        # tile height = len(b)
        thr=len(b)
        centers=[(min(run)+ (len(run)-1)//2) for run in runs]
        vals=[i[b[0]][c] for c in centers]
        cnt=collections.Counter(vals); mode=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        anoms=[(c,v) for c,v in zip(centers,vals) if v!=mode]
        res[(bi,thr)]=({'bands':b,'centers':centers,'anoms':anoms,
                        'fills':[ (int(r),int(c),int(i[r,c]),int(o[r,c])) for r,c in zip(*np.where(i!=o)) if b[0]<=r<b[-1]+1]},
                       {'gaps':[(int(r),int(c),int(i[r,c]),int(o[r,c])) for r,c in zip(*np.where(i!=o)) if not (b[0]<=r<b[-1]+1)]})
    return res

import numpy as np, collections
G=load()
def info(name):
    i=np.array(G[name+' input']); o=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    H,W=i.shape
    cnt=collections.Counter(int(v) for v in i.flat)
    mode=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    anom=sorted({v for v in cnt if v not in (0,mode)})
    # bands: maximal runs of non-all-zero rows
    bands=[];cur=None
    for r in range(H):
        row=i[r]
        if cur is None or np.any(row!=0):
            if cur: bands.append((cur[0],cur[1]))
            cur=(r,r)
        else: cur=None
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    gaps=[r for r in range(H) if np.all(i[r]==0)]
    return i,o,H,W,mode,anom,bands,gaps
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i,o,H,W,mode,anom,bands,gaps=info(name)
    fills={(r,c,int(i[r,c]),int(o[r,c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r,c]!=o[r,c]}
    print('====',name,'bands:',bands,'gaps:',gaps,'anom colors:',anom)
    for col in anom:
        rows=sorted({r for r,c in fills if int(o[r,c])==col})
        cols=sorted({c for r,c in fills if int(o[r,c])==col})
        print(' color',col,'fill rows:',rows,'fill cols:',cols)
        arows=sorted({r for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if int(i[r,c])==col]})
        acols=sorted({c for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if int(i[r,c])==col})
        print('   anomaly rows:',arows,'cols:',acols)
